outline: 本課程內容包括控制閥、控制器之介紹，程序動態應答分析，閉還路控制系統分析，控制器調諧，頻率應答分析及串級控制系統之介紹
schedule:
1st -4th  weeks review of basic concepts in chemical process and models
5th -8th weeks, time domain dynamics and control
9th - 13th weeks, laplace domain dynamics and control
14th - 17th weeks, frequency domain dynamics and control
assessment:
Midterm examination
Final examination
Quiz
Attendance
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

使用外文原文書：

Essentials of process control, by W. L. Luyben
Unit operations of chemical engineering, by W. L. McCabe
